description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Nautilus' '''[[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are empowered to deal 14 – 128 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] '''bonus''' physical damage and [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|root]] the target for 0.75 – 1.5 (based on level) seconds.
description.text: Innate: Nautilus' basic attacks are empowered to deal 14 – 128 (based on level)Category:Debug bonus physical damage and root the target for 0.75 – 1.5 (based on level) seconds.

description2.raw: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
description2.text: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

notes.raw: * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|root]] but not the bonus damage. * ''Staggering Blow's'' enhanced attack can be [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] and [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] (the on-target cooldown will still be applied). ** It will fail to trigger while he is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. *
notes.text:
Spell shield will block the root but not the bonus damage.
Staggering Blow's enhanced attack can be blocked and dodged (the on-target cooldown will still be applied).
* It will fail to trigger while he is blinded.
The empowered attack will not trigger against structures.
